name: Why would a property owner choose a confidential sale over a traditional listing?

mainEntity.name: Why would a property owner choose a confidential sale over a traditional listing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Property owners often choose a confidential sale for enhanced privacy, especially if they are public figures, have sensitive financial situations, or prefer to avoid public scrutiny during the selling process. Another common reason is to test market interest without publicly listing, or to avoid disrupting tenants or business operations. This approach limits viewings and public knowledge of the sale, which can be a key decision factor for sellers valuing discretion above maximum market exposure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sellers choose confidential sales for privacy, sensitive situations, or to avoid public scrutiny and disruption, valuing discretion over broad market exposure.
